text:
marta: Heads-up: ops requested we flip a few runtime defaults to fail-open for a 2-week experiment. want to plan safe rollout (preview UX + telemetry + ledger).
jin: ok. which flags? and do we make this per-team default or global?
marta: initial candidates: route-strict-match (-> warn), quota-auto-throttle (-> fail-open), kv-eviction-policy (-> relaxed), config-propagation-lock (-> hold-mode=false). leaning per-team preview first.
leo: per-team preview is lower risk. we should add a preview-only state so teams can opt-in from console. UI: "Enable preview defaults" toggle scoped to org.
ops-bot: checklist item created: preview-toggle + ledger-entries + preflight-run + telemetry-dashboard + canary-rollout.
ci-bot: note: we'll need an automated e2e that validates per-route behavior for 10 representative routes. add to canary pipeline.
jin: telemetry proposal: 0.5% traces + 10% counters for preview. capture labels: route, team, user_type, policy_flag. create a dashboard panel for preview-impact and a separate errors-by-override panel.
marta: gating rules: pause progression if error-rate delta > 0.3% absolute or p95 latency increases by 12%. also fail-fast on any increase in 5xxs in auth paths.
leo: console feature: "Preview Effects" modal that shows before/after for sampled requests and an export CSV of affected route-ids. also a diff view (computed config vs prod).
marta: ledger changes: ledger v2 already stores diffs + author + commit. need to add: rollout_id, preview_scope, sampling_policy. small API bump.
jin: agree. keep schema backwards compatible. propose adding rollout_id (string) and meta.tags (list).
leo: meta.tags is nice but nested. agents.md forbids nested JSON in these docs but in the real API it's fine. for our PR, just request optional rollout_id and preview_scope string.
ops-bot: PR skeleton: https://go/repo/pulls/789 (label: config-preview). assign: jin.
ci-bot: preflight script suggestion: `./bin/config-preview-check --from=prod --to=preview --routes=sampled.txt` (checks route fanout, header-presence, authorization paths).
marta: canary plan: preview enabled on 5% of teams for 4 hours, monitor, then 25% for 12h, then full opt-in window. progression requires manual approval via the umbrella ticket.
jin: OPA dry-run: run against canary cluster and ingest results into telemetry as policy_violations_by_route. auto-pause if violation count > 20 in 1hr for any single route.
leo: rollback runbook: set per-route override to previous default, emit ledger entry with reason=rollback and rollback_id, then notify #incidents and the owning team. include a one-click button in console to revert per-route.
marta: example dry-run payload we want runtime to accept:
```
{
  "flag": "route-strict-match",
  "operation": "preview",
  "preview_mode": true,
  "rollout_id": "preview-2026-03-21-1",
  "sampling": { "trace_pct": 0.5, "counter_pct": 10 },
  "scope": "team:payments"
}
```
jin: small nit: sampling percentages as floats vs ints. prefer floats for precision (0.5).
ops-bot: umbrella issue opened: https://go/repo/issues/1300 (assigns owners).
deploy-bot: started job: preview/dryrun-checker v2.0 -> canary (job 9988). :rocket:
leo: owners: ledger PR -> jin, dashboards -> marta, console UI -> me, preflight tooling -> ci-bot. I'll add subtasks.
marta: add telemetry alarms to runbook: sev2 pager if auth 5xxs increase during preview window.
jin: one more: ensure config propagation lock false doesn't create race windows. add a propagation-wait metric and block rollout if propagation-time > 30s median.
leo: good call. add chart to dashboard.
ops-bot: summary checklist posted to umbrella issue. everyone add sign-off comments once checks pass.
marta: thanks all. scheduling a 30-min sync after first canary window to review results. :thumbsup:
